2119100146978041996.en_summary: $INTC 8 years ago at $55/share was primarily an x86 CPU & PC business with no external foundry business or outside backing and no meaningful AI growth engine. Today at the same $55/share it is a centerpiece of America's push for domestic advanced chipmaking backed by U.S. government & $NVDA with Data Center & AI revenue just posting its strongest growth in 15 years. Same price, very different business.
2119100146978041996.zh_summary: $INTC 8 年前每股 55 美元時主要是 x86 CPU 和 PC 業務，沒有外部代工或外部支持，也沒有有意義的 AI 增長引擎。今天同樣每股 55 美元，它已成為美國推動國內先進晶片製造的核心，由美國政府和 $NVDA 支持，數據中心和 AI 收入剛創下 15 年來最強增長。相同價格，截然不同的業務。

2119100095341998329.en_summary: On AI trade implications of alleged Jensen relationships: $NVDA probably wanted to sell more chips to China for revenue anyway, and it is extremely unlikely this person had any effect on trade policies. The relationship might not even be true; waiting until more news comes out.
2119100095341998329.zh_summary: 關於 alleged Jensen 關係對 AI 交易的影響：$NVDA 可能無論如何都想向中國出售更多晶片以獲取收入，而這個人極不可能對貿易政策產生任何影響。這種關係可能根本不真實；等待更多新聞出來。

2119097842363211968.en_summary: A $TSM spokesperson has reportedly denied exploring 3D DRAM per Tom's Hardware, after a report from The Information stated TSMC's production plans were from $NVDA's request. Implications would have put TSMC in competition with $MU, SK Hynix and Samsung. Frustrating that market-moving headlines go both ways creating confusion and volatility, especially if $NVDA CEO honeypot allegations or the TSM report turn out untrue.
2119097842363211968.zh_summary: $TSM 發言人據報道否認探索 3D DRAM（據 Tom's Hardware），此前 The Information 報道稱 TSMC 的生產計劃來自 $NVDA 的請求。這將使 TSMC 與 $MU、SK Hynix 和 Samsung 競爭。令人檩喪的是，市場影響的頭條新聞兩邊都有，造成更多困惑和波動，尤其是如果 $NVDA CEO honeypot 指控或昨日 TSM 報道不實。
